# Lessons index

A derived, one-line-per-lesson address book for `.dev/memory-bank/lessons-learned.md`. It exists so a stage can SELECT which
lessons to fetch; canon stays the source of truth and the floor's verification target
(`pharn/floor/check-plan-lessons.mjs` reads canon, never this file).

**This index is not a substitute for reading a lesson.** Selecting a candidate here and declaring it
applied, without fetching its full `## L<n>` entry from canon, is the P0 disease. "The index was
consulted" never means "the relevant lessons were read".
